blocks.content: Inbound SCIM provisioning is a realm-level feature. Click the button below to check whether your realm administrator has enabled it. If it has not, ask the realm administrator to enable SCIM in the organizations configuration before continuing.

Pick the authentication scheme the upstream identity provider will use when it pushes SCIM requests to this organization. Most enterprise IdPs (Entra ID, Okta) expect a Bearer token, which corresponds to External Secret below.
Paste these values into the upstream identity provider's SCIM provisioning configuration. The secret will not be displayed again once you leave this step.

blocks.label: SCIM Endpoint URL
blocks.hint: Sometimes called Tenant URL, Base URL, or SCIM 2.0 endpoint

blocks.label: Bearer Token / Shared Secret
blocks.warning: Copy this value now — it cannot be recovered later. Anyone holding it can push users and groups into this organization.
blocks.hint: Only shown for External Secret and External Basic modes.

blocks.content: In the upstream identity provider's admin console, locate the SCIM provisioning or directory sync section. Paste the SCIM Endpoint URL into the tenant URL field, paste the Bearer Token or shared secret into the secret field, and test the connection. Once the test succeeds, enable provisioning and assign the users and groups that should be synced.

blocks.title: SCIM provisioning is configured
blocks.description: The SCIM endpoint is now accepting traffic for this organization. After your IdP starts pushing changes, sync events appear in the Keycloak admin console under Events.

scimGateCheck.title: Check SCIM availability
scimGateCheck.description: Reads the realm's organization configuration to confirm SCIM is enabled.

externalSecret.title: External Secret (Bearer)
externalSecret.description: Most common. The wizard generates a high-entropy Bearer token; the upstream IdP sends Authorization: Bearer <token> on every SCIM call. Used by Entra ID, Okta, OneLogin, and most enterprise IdPs.

externalBasic.title: External Basic (Username/Password)
externalBasic.description: HTTP Basic authentication. Use when the upstream IdP only supports username/password auth instead of Bearer tokens.

externalJwt.title: External JWT
externalJwt.description: Validates a JWT issued by an external identity provider. Use when the SCIM client signs its own tokens against a known JWKS.

keycloakAuth.title: Keycloak Bearer
keycloakAuth.description: The SCIM caller presents a Keycloak-issued access token and must hold the realm-management roles required to manage members of this organization. No additional credentials needed.
